decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already updates the standalone USB-powered rail from INA219 to INA3221 and removes the LEDs from that rail description; no additional change is required.
Selecting INA3221 for rail monitoring does not change the 5V boost converter, its enable control, or its powered loads.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY replacing INA219 with INA3221; the existing event fully captures the source decision.
The INA3221 selection does not entail any change to the charge-status display, external charge LED interface, or their power configuration.
Replacing the current-monitor device does not change the AXP2101 battery input, normal-operation source, or system power-path coverage.
The source decision concerns the rail-monitoring device and does not change the established 5V LED supply, level shifting, data GPIO, or standby control.
Acceptance of INA3221 does not entail a change to the daughterboard's LED count, form, selected LED part, or supply voltage.
The current-monitor substitution does not alter USB data routing, enumeration, flashing, or standalone-programming behavior.
The INA3221 selection does not affect battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or protection-component requirements.
The source decision does not change the battery NTC connector, monitoring function, or thermal-protection controller.
Changing the current-monitor device leaves the interboard connectors, pinout, board power chain, and distribution roles unchanged.
The INA3221 decision is unrelated to the battery connector family, pin functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
